unproject_depth_map_to_point_map: unproject a batch of depth maps to 3D world coordinates using camera extrinsics and intrinsics
depth_to_world_coords_points: convert a single depth map to 3D world coordinates using camera extrinsic and intrinsic matrices
depth_to_cam_coords_points: convert a depth map to camera coordinates using the camera intrinsic matrix
closed_form_inverse_se3: compute the inverse of a batch of SE3 transformation matrices in numpy or torch
review_geometry_module: review the geometry utility functions for depth map unprojection and SE3 matrix inversion
